brief: A stand to hold a 60-litre fish tank full of water.

requirements.evidence: Nothing placed. A stand shape, even if it fit, would imply load suitability the configurator does not check.
requirements.requirement: Stand to hold a fish tank

requirements.evidence: No structure built; 60 litres of water is ~60 kg plus tank weight, a sustained heavy load on 3D-printed plastic with fit-only checks.
requirements.requirement: Support 60-litre tank full of water safely (weight, stability, sustained load)

finish.summary: Declined: a stand for a 60-litre tank full of water (~60kg+ plus tank) is an unsafe heavy load and a failure risk to people, property and the fish. The configurator checks fit only and knows nothing about strength, load ratings or stability, so this cannot be verified as safe in 3D-printed Hex Cluster parts. Nothing was built. A safe alternative would be a commercially rated aquarium stand; Hex Cluster could build light accessories around it such as a supply caddy.

events.text: Declined — 60kg water load can't be verified in printed plastic. I'll record that formally.
